scope: Pure uncalled Profile3/base4 current-state closure over immutable bytes. r2 accepts System allocation states (Finished INIT, Prepared page reservation) through validate_row_base_allocation, checks Catalog-scope Job3 relations, provenance, ledger rows and XOI inventory through the shared Catalog base seam (r2..r5 failed closed with CatalogUnwired when a Catalog-scope semantic residual was needed; w1 wires the exact Profile3 Catalog ledger through catalog3::JobView instead). r3 admits a row in a Transaction-stamped table only under a committed (TerminalReady outcome 1) creator whose Catalog root is Retained, bounds committed row writers by the header source, and accepts one Row-scope Reserved root per base with exactly one UndoSlot(U) item. r4 orders every committed row after its table creator (row q > the record Committed q, or the creator Ready Terminal q while unpruned) and reports a RowReserve beside another reservation as Unsupported. r5 also orders a committed Row actor still on its Ready Terminal after its table creator (Ready q > creator q) for every Transaction-stamped row and every ReleasingCompensated Row root. Profile3 Row XOI mode reproduces the inventory page. No INIT/WAL history, source selection, replay or Profile2 behaviour change.
independence: author.py is stdlib-only, imports no engine code and reuses no engine encoder; parents are pinned by sha256 below. Catalog actor D residual rows are the contract Catalog CREATE values for C254 (dev3-catalog-create.md group table; dev3-create-job-format.md 5: Job width 1024 keeps them, Job3 is 1024).

36 relation variants each pass decode_layout and are rejected by the closure with the listed error (r3 added committed-writer-bound, create-uncommitted-row, create-uncommitted-committed-row, row-reserved-no-item, row-reserved-two-items, row-reserved-item-kind, row-reserved-twice and changed reserved-row-root; r4 adds committed-row-before-create, committed-row-before-pruned-create (Order) and row-reserved-mixed (Unsupported); r5 adds ready-writer-before-pruned-create, ready-writer-before-create and compensated-writer-before-create (Order); w1 adds d-residual-clr, d-residual-peak (Base(CatalogSemantic(BudgetMismatch))) and d-committed-head (Base(CatalogSemantic(IdentityMismatch)))).

Profile3 Row XOI mode (encode_row_current over borrowed slots/root/allocator/Job3 cells) reproduces the INVENTORY page and returns (sum wal, sum steps) of header.remaining for genesis, aging, live, state-system-reserved, state-create-retained, state-row-reserved (emits the one UndoSlot item), state-create-committed-row and (w1) state-create-reserved (emits D's three Catalog items through catalog3::JobView and global_items); 8 states.

Production source_bytes phases cover per-frame size_of inventories of every closure chain (frames, seam accessors, phases); prints ROW_BASE_SOURCE with Catalog base3 source_census/layout_source_bytes and ROW_BASE_SIZES. r3 adds the Row reservation/item, creator and header-bound chains; r5 adds the table-creator q chain to the row visitor and the compensated-root pass to tables(); w1 charges both Catalog hooks as their frame plus semantic_catalog::profile3_transaction_source_bytes (asserted <= the Profile2 transaction bound, with equal Option<JobView> sizes) and prints ROW_BASE_CATALOG_HOOK; B4 must stay below the 65536 native cap.
